description: 402 payment challenge for a webpage summary — $0.05 USDC on Base via x402. Give a public http(s) url; returns the live payment requirements plus how-to-pay steps. The rail returns a cleaned-text excerpt and key sentences automatically after settlement. Pages disallowed by robots.txt are refused before any charge. This tool never pays and never touches private keys — pay from your own wallet. Example: {url:'https://example.com'} returns the $0.05 challenge for that page.
name: qm_data_summarize
